seo.title: Human handoff with conversation history | Steps AI
seo.description: Let your team take over from your AI agent with the full conversation. Set wait times, fallback messages and email alerts, then reply from the unified inbox.

hero.title: A person steps in. The conversation stays together.
hero.body: When a customer needs your team, pass the conversation from your AI agent to a person. Your teammate reads the history, claims the request and replies in the same thread.
hero.reassurance: Full conversation history. A clear owner for each request. Replies from your inbox.

steps.title: From a request for help to a human reply.
steps.intro: Your team picks up where the agent left off.

items.title: The customer asks for a person
items.body: The conversation becomes a live request for your team to review.

items.title: A teammate claims the request
items.body: Open the live request and claim it before replying. The conversation is assigned to the teammate who takes over.

items.title: Read the history and reply
items.body: The full chat is already available. Continue in the same thread without asking the customer to start again.

items.title: Resolve the handoff
items.body: When your team has finished helping, resolve the handoff. The conversation remains in the inbox for reference.

features.title: Decide what happens while customers wait.
features.intro: Configure human handoff in your agent’s skills, with a clear message when your team cannot join.

items.title: Set a wait time
items.body: Choose 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute or 2 minutes before the fallback message appears.

items.title: Write a fallback message
items.body: Use your own text to explain what happens if nobody joins within the wait time.

items.title: Choose email recipients
items.body: Add the people who should receive an email when a customer needs your team. Leave recipients empty to turn alerts off.

items.title: Keep the conversation history
items.body: Your teammate sees what the customer asked and what the agent already answered.

items.title: Claim before replying
items.body: A team member claims the conversation and replies once it is assigned to them.

items.title: Continue from the unified inbox
items.body: Read, reply and resolve the handoff in the same place as your other customer conversations.

goodToKnow.title: Before you switch it on.
items: Human handoff is available on Starter and above.
Enable Hand over to a person under Agent → Intelligence → Skills.
A handoff request does not guarantee an immediate reply. Set a fallback message for times when nobody joins.
Once a person takes over, the conversation stays with your team until the handoff is resolved.

items.q: Does my customer need to repeat the question?
items.a: Your teammate can read the full conversation before replying, including the customer’s messages and the agent’s answers.
You set how long the customer waits and the fallback message shown if nobody joins in time.

items.q: How does my team know someone needs help?
items.a: The conversation appears as a live request. You can also configure email alerts for the recipients you choose.

items.q: Does the AI keep answering during the handoff?
items.a: Once a person takes over, the conversation is with your team until the handoff is resolved.

items.label: Unified inbox
items.body: Manage the conversation before, during and after a handoff.

items.label: Agent skills
items.body: Configure when your agent should ask for human help.

items.label: Set up human handoff
items.body: Follow the setup guide for wait times, fallback messages and email alerts.

cta.title: See how your team takes over.
cta.body: Book a demo to walk through a customer request, the conversation history and a reply from your team.
